description: Detached two storey replacement dwelling, Detached garage at front (Demolition of existing dwelling, pool and outbuildings).
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">No site works or development
shall commence until details of the levels of the building(s), road(s) and
footpath(s) in relation to the adjoining land and highway(s), and any other
changes proposed in the levels of the site, have been submitted to, and
approved by, the local planning authority.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p><br></p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">Prior to occupation of the
dwelling, details of the waste storage area including a minimum 3-bin system to
be located within the rear garden shall be submitted and approved by the local
planning authority. The refuse bins shall be stored at all times, other than on
collection days, in the designated refuse storage area, as shown on the
approved drawing.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p><br></p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">Prior to the first occupation of
the development, evidence of Secured by Design Certification shall be submitted
to the Local Planning Authority in writing to be agreed. Secure by design
measures shall be implemented and the development shall be retained in
accordance with the approved details.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p><br></p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">The window(s) at first floor
level in the flank elevations of the approved development shall:<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">a) be of purpose-made obscure
glass,<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">b) be permanently fixed closed
below a height of 1.7 metres above finished floor level and shall thereafter be
retained in that form.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p><br></p>

<p><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);">The development hereby approved shall provide for a minimum of two cycle spaces. The cycle storage shall be made</span><span style="color: rgb(51, 51, 51);"> available prior to occupation and shall be retained thereafter.</span></p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify"><span lang="EN-US">Notwithstanding the provisions of
the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or
any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no
development in relation to the proposed dwellinghouses which would otherwise
fall within Classes A, B, D, E, F and G in Part 1 of Schedule 2, and Class AA
of Part 20 of Schedule 2 to that Order shall be carried out without the prior
written permission of the local planning authority.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p><br></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><u>Biodiversity Enhancement Plan</u></p><p class="MsoNormal">Prior to the commencement of construction, a scale, colour
plan of biodiversity enhancements on the site, to include the number,
specification, and location of enhancements such as bat boxes, bird boxes,
hibernacula, hedgehog highways, and water features, shall be submitted to and
approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Thereafter, the
biodiversity enhancement measures shall be carried out and retained in
accordance with the approved details.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal">Prior to the installation of any external lighting,
details of the proposed external lighting shall be submitted to and approved in
writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include the
location, type, orientation and intensity of lighting and measures to minimise
light spill onto retained vegetation and potential wildlife habitats. <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">

</p><p class="MsoNormal">The external lighting shall be installed and thereafter
operated only in accordance with the approved details.&nbsp;<i><o:p></o:p></i></p>

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp; 6164 PL032 Rev G, 6164 PL030 Rev D, 6164 PL033 Rev F, 6164 PL031 Rev J, 24130-24-02, Fall Back Position Statement 6164/JGS/B (dated 01/07/26), Site Location Plan, 24130-24-03, 24130-24-02, Arboricultural Impact Assessment (dated 19th December 2024), Ecological Appraisal (dated December 2025), Flood Risk Assessment and SUDS Report C3490-R1-REV-D, Flood map for planning (dated 9th January 2025), Reasonable Exemption Statement, 6164 PL032 Proposed Sections

<p>The development shall be carried out in full accordance with the tree protection measures, arboricultural working methods and recommendations contained within the BS5837:2012 Tree Survey and Arboricultural Impact Assessment prepared by GHA Trees, dated 19 December 2024 (Ref: GHA/DS/160225:24), including the associated Arboricultural Impact Plan.</p><p>Prior to commencement of development (including demolition and site clearence), all tree protection measures shall be installed in accordance with the approved arboricultural details and shall thereafter be retained and maintained for the duration of the construction works.</p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;">No works about ground level shall take place until details of the
works for the disposal of sewage to be provided on site have been submitted to,
and agreed in writing by, the local planning authority. The development shall
be carried out in accordance with the works so agreed and the works shall
thereafter be retained.</p>

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the side elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.

<p>Prior to commencement of development (excluding demolition and site clearance), details of the sustainable design measures to be incorporated into the development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include:</p><p>a) a comparison of baseline carbon emissions against predicted carbon emissions following implementation of the proposed measures; and</p><p>b) measures to ensure that residential water consumption does not exceed 105 litres per person per day.</p><p>The approved measures shall be implemented in full prior to first occupation of the development and retained thereafter</p>

<p>The development shall be carried out in accordance with the flood risk mitigation and sustainable drainage measures set out in the Flood Risk Assessment ref no: C3490-R1-REV-D, dated August 2026, including the proposed finished floor level, flood compensation measures, surface water attenuation, permeable paving, rainwater harvesting and restricted discharge arrangements.</p><p>The approved drainage measures shall be fully implemented prior to first occupation of the development and thereafter retained and maintained in accordance with the maintenance arrangements set out within the approved report.</p>

<p class="CM5" style="margin-bottom: 0cm;"><span lang="EN-US">All planting, seeding or turfing
comprised in the approved details of landscaping shall be carried out in the
first planting and seeding seasons following the occupation of the building(s),
or the completion of the development, whichever is the sooner. Any existing or
new trees or shrubs which, within a period of 5 years from the completion of
the development, die, are removed, or become seriously damaged or diseased,
shall be replaced in the next planting season, with others of a similar size
and species, unless the local authority agrees any variation in writing.<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size:12pt;">Notwithstanding the details shown on the approved drawings, the development shall not progress beyond damp proof course level until samples of the materials (or appropriate specification) to be used in the construction of the external surfaces noted below have been submitted to, and agreed in writing by, the local planning authority:</span></p><p style="margin-bottom:0cm; text-align:justify" class="CM5"><span style="font-size:12pt;">a) All facing and roof materials for the buildings (including outbuildings);</span></p><p style="margin-bottom:0cm; text-align:justify" class="CM5"><span style="font-size:12pt;">b) Windows/doors/glazing; and</span></p><p style="margin-bottom:0cm; text-align:justify" class="CM5"><span style="font-size:12pt;">c) Ridge tile details for the crown roof</span></p><p style="margin-bottom:0cm; text-align:justify" class="CM5"><span style="font-size:12pt;">d) external patio and hardstanding materials&nbsp;</span></p><p style="margin-bottom:0cm; text-align:justify" class="CM5"><span style="font-size:12pt;">e) soffits and fascia details</span></p><p style="margin-bottom:0cm; text-align:justify" class="CM5"><span style="font-size:12pt;">f) cladding or similar to be applied to external walls</span></p><p style="margin-bottom:0cm; text-align:justify" class="CM5"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details so agreed and shall be retained as such thereafter.</span><span style="font-size:12pt;"><br><br><strong>Reason </strong>- REASON: To ensure that the development is carried out to the highest standards of architecture and materials.</span></p><p><br></p>

<p>The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until there has been submitted to, and approved by, the local planning authority, a scheme of hard and soft landscape works for the site including:</p><p>a) Planting
plans (at a scale not less than 1:100)</p><p>b) Schedules
of plants, noting species, plant sizes, plant container sizes (all at time of
planting) and proposed numbers / densities</p><p>c) Written
specification of planting and cultivation works to be undertaken</p><p>d) A
landscape implementation programme with proposed timing / dates for the works.</p><p>e) Boundary Treatment</p><p>f) Landscaping Scheme –
     Implementation and implementation programme, including a period of 5 year
     period for replacements of soft landscape</p><p>g) levels</p><p>h) details hard landscaping materials to be used for patio and hardstanding</p><p>i) landscape masterplan&nbsp;</p><p><br></p>
